title: Adaptive Patent Draft Validation Pipeline
field_of_invention: Document automation and governance control systems.
background: Conventional drafting workflows require repetitive manual formatting and inconsistent governance evidence tracking.
summary: A modular generation pipeline builds a draft patent application from structured input and emits deterministic output sections.
abstract: A system and method for generating patent application drafts from structured data while preserving traceable section-level output.
claims: A method for generating a patent application draft by receiving structured invention metadata and producing formatted draft sections.
The method of claim 1, wherein the output includes title, field, background, summary, abstract, and claim sections.
The method of claim 1, wherein generation output is deterministic and suitable for traceability review.
